title: Call Graph (Butterfly)
summary: Shows callers and callees of one symbol together in a single "butterfly" view
intro: Read this when you want to see who calls a symbol and what it calls together, in one butterfly view, from the IDE menu. The same chart is available from the CLI with the butterfly verb.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint reverse-calltree --qname <X> [--direction callers|callees] [--depth N] [--format text|json|dot|mermaid] [--json] --db PATH [--db ...] (N-deep call tree; callers=who calls X (default), callees=what X calls; cycle-guarded)
help: drag-lint reverse-calltree --qname <X> [--direction callers|callees] [--depth N] [--format text|json|dot|mermaid] [--json] --db PATH [--db ...]   (N-deep call tree; callers=who calls X (default), callees=what X calls; cycle-guarded)
